meta.title: SLATE grocery research, part three: drinks from more brands
meta.method: Beer, wine, coffee, tea, juice and bottled-water products were read on 2026-10-05, product by product, by searching each brand on the chain's own storefront. Price Rite, The Fresh Grocer and Smart & Final (Wynshop/Mi9 storefronts, store ids 301/197/371) answered search pages at www.<chain>.com/sm/.../rsid/<id>/results?q=<brand> with real prices and UPCs; those rows are confirmed:true. SuperValu Ireland answered the same way at shop.supervalu.ie/sm/delivery/rsid/5550/results?q=<brand>; confirmed:true. Chedraui (Mexico) answered its own VTEX catalog API directly, https://www.chedraui.com.mx/api/catalog_system/pub/products/search/<brand>?map=ft, which returns product name, EAN and price as JSON; confirmed:true. Stop & Shop, Fairway, Save-On-Foods (blocked this session with HTTP 403 after earlier research had read it; not reused here), Giant Tiger's own search, and the Mexican and Irish/GB discounters and Canadian chains either blocked automated reads outright or returned no matching brand search within the time available, so no rows for stopandshop, fairway, saveonfoods, gianttiger, voila, nofrills, tesco-ie, dunnes, lidl-ie, aldi-gb, lidl-gb, bodegaaurrera or soriana are included; nothing was invented to fill them in. Tesco and Sainsbury's rows come from Trolley.co.uk, a UK price-comparison tracker, read per product (not from its search-aggregate page, which does not label retailers): confirmed:false, with the product's Trolley.co.uk URL as the source and the retailer named in the note. Where a product was on promotion the regular (non-promotional) price is recorded and the promotional price is given in the note.

fieldNotes.sizeQty: Converted to g or ml (1 oz = 28.3495 g, 1 US fl oz = 29.5735 ml), rounded to the nearest unit. For tea bags, sizeQty is the bag count and sizeUnit is 'ct'. For multipacks of cans/bottles, sizeQty is the total ml across the pack.
fieldNotes.taxIncluded: false for US (sales tax, where it applies to alcohol/soft drinks, is added at the register); true for GB, IE and MX, where shelf prices include VAT/IVA. Ireland's alcohol prices are also subject to minimum unit pricing. No specific tax rates are asserted.
fieldNotes.abv: Recorded only where the chain's own listing or the tracker's product page stated it; null everywhere it was not stated — none was looked up from an outside source or estimated.

meta.gaps: No new drinks were confirmed for stopandshop, fairway, aldi-gb, lidl-gb, tesco-ie, dunnes, lidl-ie, saveonfoods, gianttiger, nofrills, voila, bodegaaurrera or soriana this pass: Stop & Shop and Fairway's own sites returned no usable search results in the time available; Save-On-Foods, which an earlier research pass had read successfully, returned HTTP 403 this session; Giant Tiger's own search returned no results for the brands tried; Aldi, Lidl, Tesco Ireland, Dunnes, Lidl Ireland, No Frills, Voilà, Bodega Aurrera and Soriana either block automated reads or were not found on Trolley.co.uk/item.ie, the trackers checked. This is a gap to close in a later research pass, not a claim that these chains lack new-brand drinks.
